settings.title: Choose a grow light by where your plant lives.
settings.content: Start with the spot: desk, shelf, corner, kitchen, living room, or greenhouse. Soliseed helps match the setup form to the place your plants actually grow.

settings.title: Desk Plants
settings.content: For small plant groups, compact desks, and clip-on placement.

settings.title: Plant Shelves
settings.content: For plant racks, shelf rows, and multi-level growing spots.

settings.title: Dark Corners
settings.content: For corners where natural light does not reach consistently.

settings.title: Kitchen Herbs
settings.content: For herbs on counters, windowsills, and compact kitchen spots.

settings.title: Living Room Plant Corners
settings.content: For larger houseplants and visible living spaces.

settings.title: Greenhouse & Seedlings
settings.content: For seed starts, greenhouse benches, and wider growing areas.

settings.title: Start with the growing spot.
settings.content: Each place has different constraints: distance, mounting, footprint, and how often you adjust the light.

settings.title: Need help after choosing?
settings.content: Use the setup guide for placement, distance, timer, and adjustment basics.
